challenge_hypothesis: bridged through contrary_evidence_refs to hypothesis weakening/revision path
compare_evidence: adds supporting/conflicting evidence or weakens/revises hypothesis
declare_insufficient_evidence: bridged to bounded evidence request and insufficient evidence state
identify_evidence_need: bridged to next_evidence_need and assumptions/missing evidence, but model qualification blocked
interpret_state: bridged to interpretation summary, next evidence need, and next operation proposal
prioritize_focus: bridged to selected focus action and focus proposal
propose_plan: bridged to planned action text and evidence refs
reflect_on_outcome: records outcome discrepancy and learning/revision transitions
request_operator_resolution: bridged to operator question/action and blocking interpretation
revise_hypothesis: creates revision child and supersedes prior active hypothesis
revise_plan: bridged to revised plan interpretation and revision action
summarize_learning: creates learning update and useful artifact through summarize_learning transition
